visionVerdict.notes: Both FRs visibly met: streamed reply in РОЗМОВИ, full RequestCard (Софійка + all intake fields), pending queue entry with the amber Очікує badge + Підтвердити/Запропонувати інший час/Відхилити DecisionBar, and a 5-row Пн–Пт HallMap. Two readability defects the judge flagged on the first pass were then FIXED (commit trail): (1) low-saturation seats -> now distinguished by non-color cue (border style/weight: pending solid, confirmed double, cancelled dashed+strikethrough) plus deeper fills, WCAG 1.4.1-safe; (2) clipped brief last line -> persistent scrollbar + 'ще ↓' fade cue, ends cleanly. Re-verified: axe 0 serious/critical in light AND dark; small uppercase labels legible after the --text-muted contrast fix.
